title: TFC CTF 2026
content: Jeopardy-style CTF covering miscellaneous challenges, cryptography, web security, reverse engineering, artificial intelligence, and binary exploitation.
result: MaaSec CTF team competition covering a broad range of cybersecurity topics.

title: DefCamp Capture the Flag (D-CTF) 2026 Quals
content: Jeopardy-style CTF covering miscellaneous challenges, cryptography, web security, reverse engineering, artificial intelligence, and binary exploitation. Competition is expected to be highly competitive.
result: A highly competitive CTF and a strong opportunity for the MaaSec team to test itself against experienced teams.

title: HALON Bug Bounty 2026
content: An in-person bug bounty event focused on finding undiscovered vulnerabilities across institutions in the Netherlands. MaaSec is returning following its participation in HALON 2025.
result: MaaSec returns to HALON for another opportunity to identify vulnerabilities across Dutch institutions.

title: Deadface CTF 2026
content: Jeopardy-style CTF covering miscellaneous challenges, cryptography, web security, reverse engineering, artificial intelligence, and binary exploitation.
result: MaaSec CTF team competition covering a broad range of cybersecurity topics.

title: picoCTF 2027
content: Jeopardy-style CTF covering miscellaneous challenges, cryptography, web security, reverse engineering, artificial intelligence, and binary exploitation. The competition is expected in March 2027.
result: Expected March 2027. A broad, accessible CTF covering core cybersecurity categories.

title: Guest Talk: Farzan Karimi (Moderna)
content:
A digital talk on hacking stories from tech giants — including the FIFA coin
hack — plus student Q&A on standing out for big tech and using AI in
cybersecurity. Free pizza and iced drinks.
result: Talk and Q&A with Farzan Karimi, Chief Security Officer at Moderna, on high-profile hacking stories and breaking into big tech.

title: Guest Talk: Ivan Frantic (Google Project Zero)
content:
A digital talk covering real-world security holes found in practice, his
Project Zero research, and student Q&A on breaking into FAANG cybersecurity.
Free pizza and drinks.
result: Talk and Q&A with Ivan Frantic, Tech Lead at Google Project Zero, on real-world vulnerability research.

title: Board Elections
content:
Candidates presented themselves, then voting opened to all members. Open to
anyone interested in joining the board.
result: Candidates presented to the club and members voted in the new board.

title: MaaSec Picnic
content:
The one MaaSec event that doesn’t happen in a locked room. Snacks, blankets,
and board games at Stadspark.
result: An outdoor social at Stadspark — snacks, blankets, and board games with the club.

title: Guest Lecture: Ransomware & Recovery
content:
Bart van Bavel (ICTS) broke down how ransomware incidents occur and spread,
practical response and recovery steps, and lessons for strengthening
prevention.
result: Guest lecture with Bart van Bavel (ICTS) on how ransomware incidents unfold and how organisations recover.

title: Bug Bounty Crew Registrations
content:
Open call to join the bug bounty group — no experience required. Sign-ups
closed February 10, 2026.
result: Registrations opened for the bug bounty crew, open to newcomers and experienced hunters alike; sign-ups closed February 10.
